state:
**Goal `ldap` — Stage 2 is done, and Stage 3's test server is on disk. No wire code or class has landed yet.** `docs/decisions/0278.md` is the design every later stage builds to: § 1 is the class and member roster, § 2 the `[ldap.<name>]` block, `Ldap\Settings` and the three `[capabilities.ldap]` grants (`connect`, `open`, `cleartext`), § 5 search, § 8 the type table, § 10 the error kinds, § 11 the four AD extras. Read the section a stage needs, not the whole record.

The six fragments are `designed` with empty `guardedBy`. A stage that lands a guard adds the test path to the rule's JSON under `data/rules/` and flips `status` to `shipped`. The Stage 2 check's `want` now follows `brief --where`'s chapter order (security first), and it passes.

`samba-ad` in `tests/db/compose.yaml` comes up healthy without `--privileged` (digest-pinned `smblds/smblds`, Samba 4.23.8). Its header comment owns the facts: realm `EXAMPLE.TEST`, base `DC=example,DC=test`, `CN=Administrator,CN=Users,DC=example,DC=test` / `Novis-test-1`, loopback 16389 (cleartext bind accepted) and 16636 (LDAPS, serving the `certs` leaf, whose SAN now has `samba-ad`). Checked by hand: a cleartext bind on 389 succeeds, and an empty-password bind returns `invalidCredentials` with `data 52e`. `env.docker` in `data/goals/ldap.json` names it, so the driver brings it up from now on. The Global Catalog ports 3268/3269 are not published yet.

next.title: the wire, and a directory to test against
next.note: file set: the new crate `crates/nvs-ldap/`, root `Cargo.toml`, `deny.toml`, `.github/workflows/ci.yml`.

items.text: **`crates/nvs-ldap`, made by hand**: a sans-IO BER/LDAP codec (check that `rasn-ldap` pulls no tokio and no async runtime before adopting it; `ldap3` is out), simple bind, unbind and search over `NvsTcp`/`NvsTls` (`crates/nvs-host/src/tls.rs:224` `over`), StartTLS the way `Core\Mail` upgrades. `rule:core-classes/db-crate-boundary`, `rule:concurrency/one-scheduler`, and the no-tokio check filed in `crates/nvs-runtime/tests/manifest_policy.rs:1`.

**An empty password is refused before a byte is sent, and a cleartext bind needs `tls = "none"` and the host grant**; `strongerAuthRequired` maps to `EncryptionRequired` as a unit test over a recorded response. `rule:security/ldap-empty-password-is-refused`, `rule:security/ldap-cleartext-bind-is-granted-per-host`; the directory tests skip only when nothing listens on 16636, as `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/cache/redis.rs:1286` does.

**The CI `ldap` step**, moved here from the server slice because it has nothing to run until the crate's tests exist: `docker compose -f tests/db/compose.yaml up -d --wait samba-ad` and the crate's tests, in the `database` job beside `bun nv db-matrix --all` at `.github/workflows/ci.yml:347`, under a `changes` lane that covers `crates/nvs-ldap/`. `bun nv db-matrix --down` already takes `samba-ad` down with the rest (`tools/nv/cmd/db-matrix.ts:360`).

backlog: Publish 3268/3269 on `samba-ad` when Stage 9's Global Catalog block needs them (`docs/decisions/0278.md` § 11).
Paging with the paged-results control, and referrals returned as data (goal Stage 3, `docs/agent/goals/ldap.md`).
